import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyArrowPatch
import numpy as np
import json

with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

# --- Color scheme: consistent across all panels ---
COLORS = {
    'Communicable': '#C44E52',  # muted red
    'NCD': '#4C72B0',           # steel blue
    'Injury': '#DD8452',        # amber/orange
}
BG_COLOR = '#FAFAFA'
GRID_COLOR = '#E0E0E0'
TEXT_COLOR = '#2B2B2B'
SUBTLE_TEXT = '#666666'
YEAR_COLORS = {'1990': '#888888', '2024': '#333333'}

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 10,
    'axes.facecolor': BG_COLOR,
    'figure.facecolor': '#FFFFFF',
    'axes.edgecolor': GRID_COLOR,
    'axes.labelcolor': TEXT_COLOR,
    'xtick.color': TEXT_COLOR,
    'ytick.color': TEXT_COLOR,
    'text.color': TEXT_COLOR,
})

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(22, 16))

# Layout: 2 rows x 2 columns
# Top-left: Global category totals (structural transition) - stacked bars
# Top-right: Slope/bump chart of rank changes
# Bottom-left: Income group stacked bars (1990 vs 2024 side by side)
# Bottom-right: Detailed income group comparison

gs = fig.add_gridspec(2, 2, hspace=0.35, wspace=0.30,
                      left=0.06, right=0.94, top=0.88, bottom=0.06)

# ====== SUPTITLE ======
fig.suptitle('The Global Disease Burden Transition: 1990 → 2024',
             fontsize=22, fontweight='bold', y=0.96, color=TEXT_COLOR)
fig.text(0.5, 0.925,
         'Disability-Adjusted Life Years (DALYs) by cause, category, and World Bank income group',
         ha='center', fontsize=13, color=SUBTLE_TEXT)

# ====== PANEL A: Global Category Totals (Structural Transition) ======
ax_a = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])

cat_data = data['global_category_totals']['data']
cats = ['Communicable', 'NCD', 'Injury']
vals_1990 = {d['category']: d['dalys_millions'] for d in cat_data if d['year'] == 1990}
vals_2024 = {d['category']: d['dalys_millions'] for d in cat_data if d['year'] == 2024}

x = np.array([0, 1])
width = 0.55
bottoms_1990 = np.zeros(1)
bottoms_2024 = np.zeros(1)

for cat in cats:
    ax_a.bar(0, vals_1990[cat], width, bottom=bottoms_1990[0],
             color=COLORS[cat], edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)
    ax_a.text(0, bottoms_1990[0] + vals_1990[cat]/2,
              f'{vals_1990[cat]:.0f}', ha='center', va='center',
              fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color='white')
    bottoms_1990[0] += vals_1990[cat]

    ax_a.bar(1, vals_2024[cat], width, bottom=bottoms_2024[0],
             color=COLORS[cat], edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)
    ax_a.text(1, bottoms_2024[0] + vals_2024[cat]/2,
              f'{vals_2024[cat]:.0f}', ha='center', va='center',
              fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color='white')
    bottoms_2024[0] += vals_2024[cat]

total_1990 = sum(vals_1990.values())
total_2024 = sum(vals_2024.values())
ax_a.text(0, bottoms_1990[0] + 30, f'Total: {total_1990:,.0f}M',
          ha='center', fontsize=9, color=SUBTLE_TEXT)
ax_a.text(1, bottoms_2024[0] + 30, f'Total: {total_2024:,.0f}M',
          ha='center', fontsize=9, color=SUBTLE_TEXT)

ax_a.set_xticks([0, 1])
ax_a.set_xticklabels(['1990', '2024'], fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax_a.set_ylabel('DALYs (millions)', fontsize=11)
ax_a.set_title('A. Global DALY Burden by Category', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=12)
ax_a.set_xlim(-0.5, 1.5)
ax_a.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax_a.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax_a.grid(axis='y', color=GRID_COLOR, linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.7)

# ====== PANEL B: Slope/Bump Chart — Rank Changes ======
ax_b = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])

top10 = data['top10_daly_causes']['data']
causes_1990 = {d['cause']: d for d in top10 if d['year'] == 1990}
causes_2024 = {d['cause']: d for d in top10 if d['year'] == 2024}
all_causes = sorted(set(d['cause'] for d in top10))

ax_b.set_xlim(-0.3, 1.3)
ax_b.set_ylim(11.5, -0.5)

# Draw lines for causes present in both years
for cause in all_causes:
    in_1990 = cause in causes_1990
    in_2024 = cause in causes_2024

    if in_1990:
        r1 = causes_1990[cause]['rank']
        cat = causes_1990[cause]['category']
    if in_2024:
        r2 = causes_2024[cause]['rank']
        cat = causes_2024[cause]['category']

    col = COLORS[cat]

    if in_1990 and in_2024:
        rank_shift = abs(r1 - r2)
        lw = 1.5 + rank_shift * 0.6
        alpha = 0.5 + min(rank_shift * 0.1, 0.4)
        ax_b.plot([0, 1], [r1, r2], color=col, linewidth=lw, alpha=alpha, zorder=2)
        ax_b.scatter([0], [r1], color=col, s=60, zorder=3, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)
        ax_b.scatter([1], [r2], color=col, s=60, zorder=3, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)
        ax_b.text(-0.05, r1, f'{r1}. {cause}', ha='right', va='center', fontsize=8.5,
                  color=col, fontweight='bold')
        ax_b.text(1.05, r2, f'{r2}. {cause}', ha='left', va='center', fontsize=8.5,
                  color=col, fontweight='bold')
    elif in_1990 and not in_2024:
        ax_b.scatter([0], [r1], color=col, s=60, zorder=3, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)
        ax_b.plot([0, 0.5], [r1, 11], color=col, linewidth=1.2, alpha=0.35,
                  linestyle='--', zorder=1)
        ax_b.text(-0.05, r1, f'{r1}. {cause}', ha='right', va='center', fontsize=8.5,
                  color=col, fontweight='bold')
        ax_b.text(0.52, 11, f'(dropped out)', ha='left', va='center', fontsize=7,
                  color=SUBTLE_TEXT, style='italic')
    elif in_2024 and not in_1990:
        ax_b.scatter([1], [r2], color=col, s=60, zorder=3, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)
        ax_b.plot([0.5, 1], [11, r2], color=col, linewidth=1.2, alpha=0.35,
                  linestyle='--', zorder=1)
        ax_b.text(1.05, r2, f'{r2}. {cause}', ha='left', va='center', fontsize=8.5,
                  color=col, fontweight='bold')

# Year labels at top
ax_b.text(0, -0.3, '1990', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=12,
          fontweight='bold', color=SUBTLE_TEXT)
ax_b.text(1, -0.3, '2024', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=12,
          fontweight='bold', color=SUBTLE_TEXT)

ax_b.set_title('B. Top 10 DALY Causes — Rank Changes', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=12)
ax_b.axis('off')

# ====== PANEL C: Income Group Stacked Bars (side by side) ======
ax_c = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])

inc_data = data['daly_by_income_group']['data']
income_groups = ['Low income', 'Lower-middle income', 'Upper-middle income', 'High income']
short_labels = ['Low\nincome', 'Lower-\nmiddle', 'Upper-\nmiddle', 'High\nincome']

x_pos = np.arange(len(income_groups))
bar_w = 0.35

for yi, (year, offset) in enumerate([(1990, -bar_w/2), (2024, bar_w/2)]):
    year_data = {d['income_group']: d for d in inc_data if d['year'] == year}
    bottom = np.zeros(len(income_groups))
    for cat_key, field in [('Communicable', 'communicable_pct'),
                           ('NCD', 'ncd_pct'),
                           ('Injury', 'injury_pct')]:
        vals = [year_data[ig][field] for ig in income_groups]
        bars = ax_c.bar(x_pos + offset, vals, bar_w, bottom=bottom,
                        color=COLORS[cat_key], edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.3,
                        alpha=0.85 if year == 2024 else 0.6)
        bottom += np.array(vals)

    # Year annotation above each set
    for i in range(len(income_groups)):
        ax_c.text(x_pos[i] + offset, 103, str(year), ha='center', va='bottom',
                  fontsize=7.5, color=SUBTLE_TEXT, fontweight='bold')

ax_c.set_xticks(x_pos)
ax_c.set_xticklabels(short_labels, fontsize=9)
ax_c.set_ylabel('Share of Total DALYs (%)', fontsize=11)
ax_c.set_ylim(0, 115)
ax_c.set_title('C. DALY Composition by Income Group', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=12)
ax_c.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax_c.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax_c.grid(axis='y', color=GRID_COLOR, linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.7)

# ====== PANEL D: Communicable vs NCD share — Dot/Dumbbell ======
ax_d = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])

income_groups_rev = income_groups[::-1]
y_pos = np.arange(len(income_groups_rev))

for i, ig in enumerate(income_groups_rev):
    d90 = next(d for d in inc_data if d['year'] == 1990 and d['income_group'] == ig)
    d24 = next(d for d in inc_data if d['year'] == 2024 and d['income_group'] == ig)

    # Communicable share: dumbbell
    comm_90 = d90['communicable_pct']
    comm_24 = d24['communicable_pct']
    ncd_90 = d90['ncd_pct']
    ncd_24 = d24['ncd_pct']

    # Communicable line
    ax_d.plot([comm_90, comm_24], [i + 0.15, i + 0.15],
             color=COLORS['Communicable'], linewidth=2, alpha=0.6, zorder=2)
    ax_d.scatter([comm_90], [i + 0.15], color=COLORS['Communicable'],
                s=80, zorder=3, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5, marker='o')
    ax_d.scatter([comm_24], [i + 0.15], color=COLORS['Communicable'],
                s=80, zorder=3, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5, marker='D')

    # NCD line
    ax_d.plot([ncd_90, ncd_24], [i - 0.15, i - 0.15],
             color=COLORS['NCD'], linewidth=2, alpha=0.6, zorder=2)
    ax_d.scatter([ncd_90], [i - 0.15], color=COLORS['NCD'],
                s=80, zorder=3, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5, marker='o')
    ax_d.scatter([ncd_24], [i - 0.15], color=COLORS['NCD'],
                s=80, zorder=3, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5, marker='D')

    # Annotate values
    ax_d.text(comm_90, i + 0.35, f'{comm_90:.0f}%', ha='center', fontsize=7.5,
             color=COLORS['Communicable'])
    ax_d.text(comm_24, i + 0.35, f'{comm_24:.0f}%', ha='center', fontsize=7.5,
             color=COLORS['Communicable'], fontweight='bold')
    ax_d.text(ncd_90, i - 0.35, f'{ncd_90:.0f}%', ha='center', fontsize=7.5,
             color=COLORS['NCD'])
    ax_d.text(ncd_24, i - 0.35, f'{ncd_24:.0f}%', ha='center', fontsize=7.5,
             color=COLORS['NCD'], fontweight='bold')

ax_d.set_yticks(y_pos)
ax_d.set_yticklabels([ig.replace('-', '-\n') if 'middle' in ig else ig
                      for ig in income_groups_rev], fontsize=9)
ax_d.set_xlabel('Share of Total DALYs (%)', fontsize=11)
ax_d.set_xlim(-2, 100)
ax_d.set_title('D. Communicable vs NCD Share — 1990 to 2024 Shift',
               fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=12)
ax_d.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax_d.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax_d.grid(axis='x', color=GRID_COLOR, linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.7)

# Year marker legend for panel D
ax_d.scatter([], [], marker='o', color='gray', s=50, label='1990')
ax_d.scatter([], [], marker='D', color='gray', s=50, label='2024')
ax_d.legend(loc='lower right', fontsize=9, framealpha=0.9, edgecolor=GRID_COLOR)

# ====== GLOBAL LEGEND ======
legend_patches = [
    mpatches.Patch(facecolor=COLORS['Communicable'], edgecolor='white',
                   label='Communicable (incl. maternal, neonatal, nutritional)'),
    mpatches.Patch(facecolor=COLORS['NCD'], edgecolor='white',
                   label='Non-communicable diseases (NCDs)'),
    mpatches.Patch(facecolor=COLORS['Injury'], edgecolor='white',
                   label='Injuries'),
]
fig.legend(handles=legend_patches, loc='lower center', ncol=3, fontsize=11,
           frameon=True, fancybox=True, edgecolor=GRID_COLOR,
           bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, 0.0), framealpha=0.95)

# Source note
fig.text(0.06, 0.008,
         'Data: Global Burden of Disease Study estimates, 1990 & 2024 (projected). '
         'DALY = Disability-Adjusted Life Year.',
         fontsize=8, color=SUBTLE_TEXT, style='italic')

plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=180, bbox_inches='tight',
            facecolor='white', edgecolor='none')
plt.close()
print('Saved to /app/output/result.png')

                s=80, zorder=3, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5, marker='D')

    # NCD line
    ax_d.plot([ncd_90, ncd_24], [i - 0.15, i - 0.15],

    ax_d.scatter([ncd_90], [i - 0.15], color=COLORS['NCD'],
                s=80, zorder=3, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5, marker='o')

    ax_d.text(ncd_90, i - 0.35, f'{ncd_90:.0f}%', ha='center', fontsize=7.5,
             color=COLORS['NCD'])
    ax_d.text(ncd_24, i - 0.35, f'{ncd_24:.0f}%', ha='center', fontsize=7.5,
             color=COLORS['NCD'], fontweight='bold')

ax_d.set_yticks(y_pos)
ax_d.set_yticklabels([ig.replace('-', '-\n') if 'middle' in ig else ig
                      for ig in income_groups_rev], fontsize=9)
ax_d.set_xlabel('Share of Total DALYs (%)', fontsize=11)
ax_d.set_xlim(-2, 100)
ax_d.set_title('D. Communicable vs NCD Share — 1990 to 2024 Shift',

ax_d.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax_d.grid(axis='x', color=GRID_COLOR, linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.7)

# Year marker legend for panel D
ax_d.scatter([], [], marker='o', color='gray', s=50, label='1990')

ax_d.legend(loc='lower right', fontsize=9, framealpha=0.9, edgecolor=GRID_COLOR)

]
fig.legend(handles=legend_patches, loc='lower center', ncol=3, fontsize=11,

The visualization is complete. It's a four-panel editorial chart saved to `/app/output/result.png` with:

- **Panel A**: Stacked bars showing the structural transition from communicable-dominated (1990) to NCD-dominated (2024) global DALYs
- **Panel B**: Slope chart showing rank changes of top 10 causes, with thicker lines for larger shifts
- **Panel C**: Side-by-side stacked bars comparing DALY composition across income groups in both years
- **Panel D**: Dumbbell chart showing communicable vs NCD share shifts for each income group

Consistent color coding (red = communicable, blue = NCD, orange = injury) is used across all panels with a shared legend.
